reconstruction.scope: abstract-level graph with retained full text

nodes.title: Research question
nodes.body: What phenomenon is supported by the reported observations?

nodes.title: Choose instrument and selection
nodes.body: Different light curve fitting methods, SN Ia subsamples, and prior constraints unanimously favor eternally expanding models with positive cosmological constant (i.e., Omega_Lambda > 0) and a current acceleration of the expansion (i.e., q_0 < 0).

nodes.title: Acquire and analyze observations
nodes.body: We present observations of 10 type Ia supernovae (SNe Ia) between 0.16 < z < 0.62.

nodes.title: Primary reported result
nodes.body: Fixing a ``minimal'' mass density, Omega_M=0.2, results in the weakest detection, Omega_Lambda>0 at the 3.0 sigma confidence level.

nodes.title: Published conclusion
nodes.body: Presently, none of these effects reconciles the data with Omega_Lambda=0 and q_0 > 0.
